{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the target population: converted == 1
df_converted = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Check how many rows are in the converted group
len_converted = len(df_converted)

# Check how many of those have age == -1
missing_age_count = (df_converted['customer_age'] == -1).sum()

# Compute mean age, excluding -1 values
mean_age = df_converted[df_converted['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age'].mean()

print(f'Number of converted customers: {len_converted}')
print(f'Number with missing age (age == -1): {missing_age_count}')
print(f'Mean age of converted customers (excluding -1): {mean_age:.2f}')"}
